Option --trusted-host is not copied from requirements.in to requirements.txt
<!-- Describe the issue briefly here. -->

#### Environment Versions

1. OS Type: Mac OS
1. Python version: `Python 3.7.3`
1. pip version:  `pip 19.3.1 from /.venv/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pip (python 3.7)`
1. pip-tools version: `pip-compile, version 4.2.0`

#### Steps to replicate

1. `echo "--trusted-host exmaple.com" | pip-compile - -qo-`

#### Expected result

```bash
#
# This file is autogenerated by pip-compile
# To update, run:
#
#    pip-compile --output-file=- -
#
--trusted-host exmaple.com
```

#### Actual result

```bash
#
# This file is autogenerated by pip-compile
# To update, run:
#
#    pip-compile --output-file=- -
#
```

#### Additional context

Caught by @altendky, see https://github.com/jazzband/pip-tools/pull/824#issuecomment-544758205.
Related issues/PRs: #338, #371
